description: In gleam_rules.ml (~line 220) the local is_test_file compares a 9-char substring against the 11-char string "_test.gleam" (always false) and its other disjunct requires the path to end in bare "_test" with no extension. Real Gleam files end in .gleam, so the function always returns false and let assert in *_test.gleam files is still flagged as an error — contradicting the documented intent ('let assert is fine in tests'). Fix: delete the local copy and use the shared Crystal_rules_helpers.is_test_file / is_test_or_spec_file (already included at the top of the file), which handle /test/ directories. Add a regression fixture test/test gleam pair.
title: detect_let_assert: is_test_file never matches real paths
